race.title: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Handicap Hurdle (Div 2)
race.verdict: RATEMENOW picked up where he left off in the spring when finding only a handicap debutant too good at Market Rasen on his reappearance and is the percentage call to go one better on the back of a breathing operation. Fourofakind showed more promise than the bare result suggests back from another break at Carlisle on his most recent outing and needs a close look having fallen a long way in the weights, with stable-switcher Je Mr Dawson also of interest. RATEMENOW (IRE) FOUROFAKIND (IRE) JE MR DAWSON (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Ratemenow (5/2), Dante's Inferno (3/1), Shadow Chaser (13/2), Pepite De Saphir (7/1), Je Mr Dawson (8/1), Jeepydoff Meel (12/1), Fourofakind (14/1), Wise Move (14/1), Khaleesi Queen (14/1), George's Angel (50/1)
